##### **Executive Summary** 

##### **Highlights of internat

ional copper market** 

In Q4 2012, global refined copper output was 5.074Mt, up by 3.3% y-o-y or 1.1% q-o-q; consumption was 5.049Mt, up by 5.3% y-o-y or 3.2% q-o-q. For the full year, as growth of global refined copper consumption sharply slowed down and growth of output expanded, global refined copper supply and demand transferred from a little shortage to a small surplus. In particular, due to huge import of China, refined copper supply was tight in other countries and areas except China. 

Global copper concentrate output in Q4 was 3.31Mt, up by 7.5% y-o-y or 1.2% q-o-q; demand was 3.36Mt, up by 6.0% y-o-y or 2.4% q-o-q, there existed a shortage. For the whole of 2012, both of copper concentrate output and demand increased, the gap between copper concentrate supply and demand was basically the same as 2011. 

##### **Global refined copper supply and demand** 

In Q4 2012, although refined copper capacity in global major copper producing countries increased slightly, capacity utilization rate has improved compared with Q3, thus global refined copper output continued to keep a stable growth; increment was mainly from Africa and Asia, especially in China, whole output in South America showed little change, but output in traditional refined copper producing countries such as Chile and Peru was higher than Q3. 

In respect of consumption, good Chinese economic data brought out benefit to demand, but the recovery was still modest; demand in United States recovered slowly; copper product demand in Europe was still weak, but the downward tendency has stopped and copper market changed to stabilize, which showed a good prospect in metal market. Stable demand had limited support for copper price in an unpredictable market environment. 

In Q4 2012, global refined copper output was 5.074Mt, up by 3.3% y-o-y or 1.1% q-o-q; consumption was 5.049Mt, up by 5.3% y-o-y or 3.2% q-o-q. For the full year, as growth of global refined copper consumption sharply slowed down and growth of output expanded, global refined copper supply and demand transferred from a little shortage to a small surplus. In particular, due to huge import of China, refined copper supply was tight in other countries and areas except China. 

Although uncertain global economy affected smelters and slow growth of refined copper consumption also led smelters to decrease their enthusiasm for production, new commissioned capacity and increasing copper concentrate supply still promoted the fast growth of refined copper output. Growth rate of global refined copper output in 2013 will hopefully exceed 3.5% (2012) and reach 4.1%, output will reach about 20.65Mt. 

Growth rate of Chinese demand in 2013 will still be less than the past several years and

In Q4 2012, global copper concentrate continued to rise. Copper concentrate TC/RC on sport market in Q4 was higher than Q3, touching the highest level in the year, which showed improvement of global copper concentrate supply. Smelting capacity was continuously putting into operation and reaching production target, led by China, inventory demand and tight copper scrap supply supported demand of copper concentrate; other factors such as after 53 days maintenance, a smelting plant of Codelco in Chuquicamata, Chile resumed production at the end of Sept., also showing growth of copper concentrate demand. Therefore the increasing output has not eased tight supply efficiently. Global copper concentrate output in Q4 was 3.31Mt, up by 7.5% y-o-y or 1.2% q-o-q; demand was 3.36Mt, up by 6.0% y-o-y or 2.4% q-o-q, there existed a shortage. For the whole of 2012, both of copper concentrate output and demand increased, the gap between copper concentrate supply and demand was basically the same as 2011. According to incomplete statistics, there were 47 copper mining projects under construction overseas, most of them will be commissioned in 2013 and 2014, of which, 20 projects with capacity of 1.217Mtpy will be commissioned in 2013, thus global copper concentrate output will increase continuously in 2013, output will reach 13.62Mt, slightly up by 6.0% compares with 2012. 5 Smelting capacity expansion led by China will still stay in a peak period, due to fast copper smelting capacity expansion, copper concentrate demand basically depends on supply, thus global copper concentrate demand will keep a fast growth in 2013 and it will reach 13.55Mt, up by 3.8%. The net imported reduced by 15.4% QoQ to 658kt. The domestic production grew by 7.3% QoQ to 1.537Mt, but due to the reduction in net import, the domestic supply fell by 0.7% to 2.195Mt in Q4. In the meanwhile, the refined consumption rebounded to 2.03Mt, the surplus was 165kt. Both supply and demand of copper concentrate on Chinese market increased, with demand rising in a higher pace. The surplus in Q4 was 89kt, slightly lower than 108kt in Q3.Supply of copper-in-concentrate increased to 1.0 Mt. The domestic production was 421kt in Q4, Import was 593kt, up by 5.5% and 9.0% qoq. The demand was 89kt, up by 12.8%. ##### **Chinese Copper Price** ##### **Copper price fluctuates violently in Q4** Fears of European finance system and global economic growth by investors in Oct. 2012 to offset advantages of easing monetary policy implemented by global main economy. Meanwhile weak demand in China also led copper price to plunge. Copper price stayed steady due to Chinese economy boomed out in Nov. and it rebounded in early Dec. However, “Fiscal Cliff” in United States and Euro Zone’s Crisis still controlled copper price, plus investors were less enthusiastic towards the end of the year, copper price dropped again. In Q4 2012, average copper price on LME and 3 month average price on LME was US$7,908/t and US$7,921/t respectively, up by 2.49% and 2.58% q-o-q, or up by 5.61% and 5.48% y-o-y, respectively. Throughout 2012 copper price presented a narrow fluctuation without direction and the fluctuation range was less than US$1,500. Closing price of 3 month price on LME on the last trading day of 2012 increased by 4.4% compared with that on the last trading day of 2011. 6 In 2012, average copper price on LME and 3 month average price on LME was US$7,949/t and US$7,946/t, down by 9.87% and 10.05% y-o-y, respectively. The copper price on domestic market basically followed the LME price and it increased in Sept. and dropped again in the middle of Oct. due to fears of economy and demand, there were signs that copper price might rebound in the middle of Nov. and it slightly rebounded at the beginning of Dec. but uncertainty of “Fiscal Cliff” in United States led copper price to show a weak tendency at the end of the year. In Q4 2012, average copper price on SHFE and 3 month average price on SHFE was 57,096yuan/t a

nd 57,128yuan/t, up by 0.81% and 1.03% q-o-q, or up by 1.96% and 2.02% y-o-y, respectively. Copper price on SHFE stayed in a stage of fluctuation and consolidation in 2012, the ratio was still low and global price was higher than domestic price. Closing price of 3 month price on SHFE on the last trading day of 2012 increased by 4.4% compared with that on the last trading day of 2011. **Chart 2 Inventory and Closing Price of LME 3-M Cu** ##### **Sulfuric acid prices maintains stable** The price of imported sulfur, which is the raw material for making sulfuric acid, went down to 1,403yuan/t in Q4 from 1,518yuan/t in Q3, putting pressure on acid price. The export of phosphate fertilizer was expected to enter the peak season in Q4, but was affected negatively by the lifted export tariff. There was no recovery sign in other end uses such as pigment dioxide and chemicals. The average price of acid was about 396yuan/t, down by 28.39% yoy. The domestic production of acid was estimated to be 18.7Mt in Q4, a fall of 2.8% yoy. While the production in 2012 would be 75.32Mt, a growth of 1.55% over 2011. The apparent consumption would be 76.23Mt, up by 1.87% yoy. The fundamentals of acid market in 2013 is expected to be better than 2012. The average price will be higher than 2012. It will wave in the range of 400-500yuan/t. Although the domestic capacity will continue to increase, the consumption will turn better, due to: first, export policy on phosphate fertilizer is more favorable, the off-season was moved to May-September, the export tariff was 5%; second, the inspection fee for imported sulfur was cancelled since Nov. 2012, which lowered the cost of import. 9 ##### **Chart 3 Sulfuric Acid Price in China 2008-2011 Yuan/t** **Chinese Copper Material Supply** ##### **Mining capacity** Around 70ktpa copper-in-concentrate capacity was commenced in 2012 including the expansion projects of Jiangxi Copper Company and Duobaoshan Copper Mine owned by Zijin Mining. The expansion project of Dexing Copper Mine has been commissioned gradually since 2009, it was completed in 2012. The expansion projects are as following: #####  **China National Gold Corporation** The Stage 2 of Wunugetushan Cu-Mo Project, owned by China National Gold Corporation, was put into trial production in April, which indicated the project was basically finished. The total investment in Stage 2 was around 350 Mln yuan, the processing capacity was 35ktpd. When it operates in full swing, the processing capacity of the project will increase to 70ktpd and the production of copper-in-concentrate and moly-in-concentrate will be 80kt and 10kt. The Mine is located in Hulun Buir City in Inner Mongolia. It is an open pit mine. The Stage 1, with processing capacity of 30ktpa and investment of 280 Mln yuan, was put into production in the end of 2009. The mining area is about 9.8 square meters, the proved copper reserve and molybdenum reserve w

as 1.268 Mt (Cu) and 258kt (Mo), the copper grade was 0.46% and molybdenum grade was 0.055%. 

The project processed 11.55Mt copper ores and produced 48.5kt copper-in-concentrate. 

#####  **Xinjiang Xinxin Mining** 

Huangshan Cu-Ni Project, owned by Xinxin Mining, was started in June 2010. The investment 

10 

was 1.0 Bln yuan. The first stage with capacity of 1,500tpd was commissioned in October 2010. The second stage with capacity of 4,000tpd was completed by the end of 2012 and is expected to be commenced in 2013. 

The Mine was located in 130 km southeast of Hami City, Xinjiang Region. The proved Cu+Ni reserve is 80Mt, containing 380kt nickel metal, 220kt copper metal and 32k cobalt metal. 

 **Jiangxi Copper Company** 

-- Dexing Copper Mine The investment in the expansion project was 2.7 Bln yuan, the project was finished in 2012. The processing capacity increased from 100ktpd to 130ktpd. Additional 41kt copper-in-cocentrate, 61kg gold metal and 25t silver metal can be produced. 

-- Chengmenshan Copper Mine The Stage 2 of was started in December 2009. The investment is nearly 500 Mln yuan. The construction was finished by the end of 2011. It is now in trial operation. 

The current processing capacity is 2,000tpd. It can produce 6,000t copper-in-concentrate. When the expansion project operates in 100% capacity, the processing capacity of the Mine will reach 7,000tpd, and it can produce 14.8kt copper-in-concentrate. 

JCC’s plan was to produce 210kt copper-in-concentrate, up by 3.96% over 2011. The grow rate was much lower than that in 2011, which was 17.44%yoy. 

 **Zijin Mining Group Co., Ltd. (Zijin Mining)** 

Zijinshan Gold & Copper Mine, owned by Zijin Mining, is expanding its flotation capacity. It plans to lift the capacity to 30ktpa copper-in-concentrate by 2015. The concentrate will be supplied to its smelter in Shanghang with capacity of 200ktpa. In addition, its 20ktpa SX-EW plant has passed the examination by the relative officials and experts recently and is expected to resume production in H1 2013. 

 **Hami Yanxin Copper Co., Ltd. (Yanxin)** 

The construction of Tuwu Copper Mine was started in February 2010. It was built by two stages, each stage with capacity of 5,000tpd. The first stage is open-pit mining, scheduled to be put into production by the end of 2011. But it was delayed. In October 2012, it was completed and put into trial operation. 

The Mine, owned by Yanxin, is located at 130km southwest of Hami City in Xinjiang. 

 **Heilongjiang Duobaoshan Copper Company (Duobaoshan Company)** 

Duobaoshan Copper Mine’s Stage 1 processing project was in trial operation in H1 2012. The capacity is 25ktpd and investment in the project is about 2.66 Bln yuan (including the cost of getting mining right and land-use). Its designed capacity of copper-in-concentrate is 30ktpa. The company is planning to expand the processing capacity to 500ktpd, which is scheduled to be completed in H2 2014. 

 **Runxin Mining Co., Ltd.

(Runxin)** Hudehe Copper Mine’s 6.0Mt processing plant was started in September 2011. The investment is 1.466 Bln yuan. It can produce 15ktpa copper-in-concentrate when it is operational. 11 The mine, owned by Runxin, is a large scale porphyry copper mine, located in Tuoli County in Xinjiang. The proved copper reserve is 362.5kt. #####  **Tongling Tongshan Mining Company (Tongling Mining)** **Tongling Mining** ’s deep mining project was started in September 2011. The processing capacity is 2kt/d and 660ktpa. It can produce 5,000t copper-in-concentrate. It is estimated to be completed by the end of 2013. ##### **Import of raw materials** ##### **Copper blister:** China imported increasing volume of copper blister in Q4, which was 140kt, up by 5.0% QoQ. The import in the whole year would be 524kt, a big jump of 25.9% yoy. The import of copper blister set record high of 58.7kt in Nov., mainly because the import from Chile doubled that in the previous month. China imported 479.3kt copper blister in Jan.-Nov., up by 26.1% yoy. Copper blister were mainly imported from Zambia, Chile and DR Congo, accounting for 34.1%, 30.1% and 19.3%, respectively. Peru supplied more copper blister, which jumped from 2,528t to 37.1kt. **Chart 4 Monthly Import of Copper Blister in 2007-2012** Monthly Import of Copper
